title: Sheep
textBlocks:
Who takes care of sheep?
Who protects the sheep from danger
from wolves, lions, bears and hyenas?

THE SHEPHERD DOES

DID YOU KNOW THAT DAVID WAS A SHEPHERD
AND DAVID WROTE THIS CHAPTER IN THE BIBLE - PSALM 23

JESUS IS OUR SHEPHERD
WE ARE JESUS SHEEP
JESUS LOOKS AFTER US IF WE FOLLOW HIM
